item.title: Which Is Your Favorite Track From Drake’s New Albums ‘Iceman,’ ‘Habibti’ & ‘Maid of Honour’? Vote!
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to "Trending Now" on Billboard. Today, we're talking about the one and only Drake. The Canadian rap superstar has just dropped not one, not two, but three new albums: Iceman, Habibti, and Maid of Honour.
[Short music transition]
Host: Let's start with Iceman. This album has been highly anticipated, with viral streams and singles like "What Did I Miss?" and "Which One" featuring Central Cee. Iceman features guest appearances by Molly Santana, 21 Savage, and Future. Yes, that's the same Future who was involved in a major rap battle with Drake in 2024. The album takes a look at Drake's last few years, with tracks like "National Treasures" and "Make Them Cry".
[Short music transition]
Host: Next up is Maid of Honour, which features summer-ready bangers like "Cheetah Print" with Sexyy Red and "Outside Tweaking" with Stunna Sandy. This album is perfect for the club, the car ride, or just a fun day out. With appearances by Popcaan, Central Cee, and more, Maid of Honour is the soundtrack for anyone who loves being outside.
[Short music transition]
Host: And finally, we have Habibti, which translates to "my dear" in Arabic. This album showcases Drake's R&B side, with collaborations by Qendresa, Loe Shimmy, Partynextdoor, and Sexxy Red. Standout tracks include "Slap the City" and "I'm Spent". With over 43 new songs to choose from, we want to know: which album is your favorite? Let us know by voting in our poll.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to "Trending Now" on Billboard. We'll catch you on the next episode!
